[[File:WookieeTotem_Crafter.png|thumb|right|200px|A Wookiee totem of a crafter]]
A '''Wookiee totem''' was a small figurine made out of stone which was crafted in the shape of a specific person or of someone performing a specific action, such as [[Artisan/Legends|crafting]]. The [[Myyydril]] tribe within the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] were known to craft them.
